total_model.summary: Model projects 45.3 total points (PIT 23, DEN 23). Biggest factors: Combined quarterback ratings (raises total 1.4), Wind x pass rate (lowers total 1.2), Combined offense EPA/play (last 8 games) (raises total 1.0). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.
